# kiln v0.7.2

v0.7.2 re-releases v0.7.0's runtime behaviour so the release is signed by its own tag. It has the same code as the v0.7.1 tag. Only the release workflow's macOS x86_64 runner differs.

## Why this release exists
v0.7.0's tag-push release run (40884009877) failed while installing qemu-user. Its assets were rebuilt from main by `workflow_dispatch`, so their cosign certificate names `release.yml@refs/heads/main`, not the tag.

v0.7.1 was cut to fix that. Its tag-push release run (42918696840) built 6 of 7 targets, but GitHub no longer offers the `macos-14` runner image ("The configuration 'macos-14-arm64-us-default' is not supported"). The x86_64-apple-darwin job was cancelled, and no GitHub Release was created. The `v0.7.1` tag exists but has no release assets. It is not rebuilt.

v0.7.2 builds x86_64-apple-darwin on `macos-15-intel` and comes from its own tag-push run, so `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed as `https://github.com/pulseengine/kiln/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/tags/v0.7.2`. Verify with the exact identity:

```
cosign verify-blob --bundle SHA256SUMS.txt.cosign.bundle \
  --certificate-identity 'https://github.com/pulseengine/kiln/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/tags/v0.7.2' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  SHA256SUMS.txt
```

When a tag's release run fails, main is fixed and the next patch tag is cut. An old tag is not rebuilt from main.

## Changes since v0.7.0
Code changes outside CI and traceability data (`git diff v0.7.0..v0.7.2`):
- **kiln-wasi: `WasiDispatcher::dispatch` removed** (SR-99, #641). This was the value-ABI entry point. Nothing in the workspace called it outside tests: kiln and kilnd reach WASI only through `HostImportHandler::call_import` → `dispatch_core`, which is unchanged. The removed path returned wrong `wasi:filesystem` error codes and left `open-at` and `stat` partly implemented. This removes a public method from the kiln-wasi library. No kiln crate is published to crates.io, so only path dependents are affected. The `kiln` binary's behaviour does not change.
- **kiln-wasi value path: `unlink-file-at` removes a symlink, not its target** (SR-95, #637). This fix landed on the value path before that path was deleted. The core path, the one kiln uses, already behaved this way in v0.7.0 and is unchanged.
- **Dependency updates in `Cargo.lock`:**
  - futures-core, futures-task and futures-util 0.3.31 → 0.3.34. This drops `pin-utils` (RUSTSEC-2026-0441, unmaintained), which was never in the shipped binary (#629, #631).
  - libc 0.2.186 → 0.2.191, log 0.4.34 → 0.4.35, smallvec 1.15.1 → 1.16.4, tokio 1.53.3 → 1.54.1.
  - toml and toml_* patch updates.
  - wasmparser, wasm-encoder, wast and wat 262/1.262 → 263/1.263.
- **CI:**
  - `release.yml` installs `qemu-user` for the musl aarch64 check, and PRs run the same check (SR-68, #608).
  - `release.yml` builds x86_64-apple-darwin on `macos-15-intel`.
  - Verus finds `rustc` on the new macOS image (#619).
  - Actions are pinned to commit SHAs (#613).
  - A PR-time MSRV check holds `parking_lot` at 0.12 for the VxWorks SDK's rustc 1.85 (SR-80, #618).

The release notes, known limitations and falsification statement of v0.7.0 still apply: https://github.com/pulseengine/kiln/releases/tag/v0.7.0

## Falsification statement
This release is wrong if:
- `cosign verify-blob` with the identity above does not print `Verified OK` for this release's `SHA256SUMS.txt`;
- any statement in v0.7.0's falsification statement is observed with v0.7.2's `kiln`;
- `kiln` behaves differently from v0.7.0's on any input, beyond what the dependency updates listed above explain;
- the x86_64-apple-darwin `kiln` archive does not run on an Intel Mac.
